exposure: clinical situations contributing to cesarean deliveries as per Robson's classification system
cohort: The study included 1,141 women who delivered at V N Desai Hospital between October 2022 and October 2023.
finding: Out of 1,141 women who delivered, 61% (702 women) underwent cesarean sections, with most belonging to Robson groups II and V.
mod_finding: Women with a previous cesarean delivery represented an increasing proportion of cesarean deliveries.
